fast_checks: uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run lint-imports && uv run deptry src && uv run pytest -m "not slow and not benchmark and not browser"; for a change to the interface also uv run pytest -m browser
layer_boundary_check: import-linter (uv run lint-imports; layers cli -> web -> app -> stages -> core)
autonomy_horizon: until Colin asks to stop or no open issues are left to work on
owner_hand_steps: listening test (rows scored 1 to 5) and the VoiceOver pass
speed run (scripts/speed.py) on the M4 and the Dependabot check
pushing release tags and PyPI publishing
repository settings and rulesets, milestone creation or renaming that only Claude asked for
notify_triggers: a release is tagged and shipped
a critical decision or a critical merge (one line)
lane_mapping_note: Execution lanes are who works; lane:* labels (.github/lanes.yml) are which files a PR may touch. extraction/voices -> lane:extraction, lane:voices, lane:output. layout -> lane:layout. textprep -> lane:textprep (incl. src/sci2audio/testing). app/release -> lane:app, lane:cli (and lane:web when a PR spans both). web -> lane:web (src/sci2audio/web, static, templates, browser tests). docs -> lane:docs (docs/, CLAUDE.md, KB process text). app and web share files often, so LANE-02 keeps them apart unless their PRs touch disjoint files (D-761 B7/B8). lane:core and lane:infra are shared and critical; lane:infra is the lock. (D-765)
critical_areas: layer contracts (lint-imports layers, voice plugin contract, text-step interface)
KB process, contract or architecture documents (excluding the daily decision-log PR)
golden files (corpus truth files, syrupy snapshots, English regression cases)
anything that deletes or overwrites user files
telemetry_check: browser tests fail on any request outside the test server (tests/browser/)
custom_invariants: Faithful text: text steps propose marked edits (remove, replace, pause, ask) with a reason; nothing rewrites text silently and nothing summarises (D-57). [check: English regression cases, tests/regression]

Text steps pass the second-run idempotency check, the Hypothesis property tests and the fuzz check; a new skip rule applies to every rule the fuzz check covers (D-699). [check: property and fuzz tests in tests/unit]

A golden file (corpus truth file, syrupy snapshot, English regression case) changes only in a critical PR that explains the diff; made-up fixtures stay separate from corpus golden tests (D-69). [check: critical_paths label risk:high]
Any change that can affect output is judged with the corpus comparison on a local merge of main: every unexpected output file stays byte-identical (D-714). [check: review only]

A branch behind main merges on its own green reviewed head; it is updated with a merge commit only on a conflict or when the PR touches files that changed on main since review, and then merges pinned to the new head after CI (D-760, Colin 18 Nov 2026). A failure that also fails on main does not block a PR; the round report names the main run (D-738). If main goes red, the lane that merged last fixes or reverts before any other PR merges (D-760). [check: CI on main]
A mutation claim in a PR body names the exact command, the test paths and the clean baseline run that passed first; mutants run from a clean worktree (D-676). [check: review only]

A flaky test gets an issue the same day; the 40-run isolation per browser runs through isolate.yml after the same-day quarantine and its result goes into the issue; a found code cause fixes the test and lifts the quarantine; a flaky ZAP scan is re-run once (D-682, D-739, D-602). [check: .github/workflows/isolate.yml]

Every issue carries a milestone, a lane label and, where it applies, risk:high or risk:low; an issue without acceptance criteria is not started, the thread asks the coordinator for them first (D-702, D-738). [check: review only]

The decision log is governance/kb/decision-log.md in this repository (moved from dubidu22/sci2audio-design on 20 Nov 2026); pending decisions collect in governance/kb/pending-decisions.md and the KB thread merges them in one PR per day. A row is 'Decided' when Colin stated or approved it (his words and time quoted) and 'Decided (Claude)' otherwise; a revised older row gets a status note naming the newer entry (D-714). [check: KB thread only]

Release: R1 sets version, CHANGELOG and README on release/X.Y; R2 is the release-day PR with Colin's hand-step results and the changelog date; R3 forward-merges release/X.Y into main after the tag, then the milestone closes. The release-checklist runs (ZAP, nightly, mutation) run on the release branch (D-669, D-714). [check: docs/release-checklist.md]
owner_prefs: Terminal commands for Colin carry no comments inside the code block; explanations go beside it.

For a decision the coordinator would otherwise put to Colin, or a real open choice in a critical plan, the coordinator first asks one advisor thread on Fable 5.1 medium effort for a second opinion: it reads only, writes no files, answers once, and the D-entry quotes its verdict.
